name: Sten Stoutarm
summary: Outside Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm keeps recruits equipped and local messages moving through Coldridge Valley. He helps young mountaineers stay warm, fed, and informed in the harsh mountain conditions.

sections.title: A Helping Hand in the Snow
sections.body: Outside Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm meets new dwarven and gnomish recruits near the tavern. Coldridge Valley is cut off by winter blizzards and faces dangers nearby. Sten provides green apprentices with sturdy gear so they can face the snow prepared.

sections.title: Keeping the Lines Open
sections.body: Sten gathers wolf hides to make winter clothing and handles messages in Coldridge Valley. He carries dispatches through dangerous Coldridge Pass and delivers official runes, memoranda, and orders to class trainers across the basin. Troggs block the tunnels, but young warriors, priests, and mages still need their instructions.

faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm outfits recruits and carries messages from his post outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He helps fresh arrivals get warm clothing and local mail delivered.

faq.q: What role does he play in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Sten equips apprentices and handles courier work for Anvilmar. He gathers wolf meat and pelts for protective gear, then routes correspondence and training memoranda across the valley.

faq.q: Why does Sten need mail delivered?
faq.answer: Troggs and winter weather endanger Coldridge Pass, making it hard for mail and supplies to reach the valley. When messages arrive, Sten asks dependable newcomers to deliver parcels and letters to residents such as Talin Keeneye.

faq.q: What does Sten think about the troggs in the valley?
faq.answer: Sten is weary of the troggs infesting the surrounding hills. He remarks that once you have seen one trogg, you have seen them all.

faq.q: Why does he ask for wolf meat?
faq.answer: Sten trades warm, durable gloves for tough wolf meat. The meat helps feed the valley's defenders, while the gloves protect them from Dun Morogh's cold.

faq.q: What are the runes and memoranda Sten gives to new adventurers?
faq.answer: The runes and memoranda are sealed letters and training tokens sent by superiors across Ironforge and Dun Morogh. They direct young apprentices to report to their class trainers inside Anvilmar.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can count on Sten's practical hospitality in Dun Morogh. He makes sure you have thick leather and food before you head into the snow.
As a gnomish refugee training alongside dwarves in Anvilmar, you face Sten's practical expectations too. He sends you with mail and gear for the elements.
As an Alliance member, you depend on communication through Coldridge Pass to keep Ironforge's training grounds connected. Sten carries mail across the valley.
